title: Juicy Vietnamese Pancetta Noodles
description: A yeasty and velvety Vietnamese dish featuring pancetta, perfect for a brunch mood, this pescatarian-friendly recipe combines the savory flavors of pancetta with the freshness of Vietnamese ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the rice noodles for 3-5 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and cook the diced pancetta until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and lime juice, then pour the mixture over the pancetta and garlic in the skillet.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, pancetta mixture, and yeast, tossing to coat the noodles evenly.
Season the noodle mixture with salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions and a wedge of lime, if desired.
